# beeyyo

> beeyyo is a grocery delivery app coming soon to Kasaragod, Kerala, India.

## About

beeyyo plans to bring groceries, snacks, and everyday essentials to doorsteps across Kasaragod. The service is not yet launched; the landing page announces its upcoming availability.

## Website

- https://beeyyo.com/

## Contact

- Email: support@beeyyo.com

## Relevant topics

- Grocery delivery in Kasaragod
- Online grocery shopping
- Snacks and everyday essentials
